soft_limits_per_task.handling: Crossing a per-task soft limit requires a timestamped explanation and mandatory human review before that task continues. It never raises an absolute task or experiment ceiling and never authorizes Stage B.

cost_estimate.basis: At most 40 experimental agent calls across five tasks, including feasible control arms, with a hard aggregate provider-cost ceiling of USD 100 and no participant payment or acquisition spend.
cost_estimate.telemetry_rule: Record actual provider-reported cost and tokens when available; otherwise mark them unavailable and never estimate missing telemetry as zero.
